description: Check any card number with the Luhn algorithm and detect its brand — a format check only, never a real-card check.

faqs.a: The Luhn algorithm doubles every second digit from the right, sums all digits (subtracting 9 where a double exceeds 9), and the total must be a multiple of 10. It catches typos, not fraud.
faqs.q: How does the Luhn check work?

faqs.a: No. It only checks that the number is well-formed. A 'valid' result says nothing about whether the card is real, active, or has funds.
faqs.q: Does 'valid' mean the card is real?

faqs.a: No. The number is checked in memory in your browser and is never stored, logged or sent anywhere.
faqs.q: Is my card number stored or sent anywhere?

howto: Type or paste the card number (spaces and dashes are fine).
Read the result and the detected brand (Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Discover).
Remember: this is a format check only — it cannot verify a real card.
title: Credit Card Validator
